 describe("index.js", function () {
+  for (const platform of ["linux", "win32"]) {
+    describe(`null characters on '${platform}'`, function () {
+      beforeEach(function () {
+        sinon.stub(os, "platform").returns(platform);
+      });
+
+      afterEach(function () {
+        os.platform.restore();
+      });
+
+      for (const method of ["escape", "escapeAll", "quote", "quoteAll"]) {
+        it(`${method} removes all null characters before escaping`, function () {
+          for (const input of ["\0", "\0foo", "foo\0bar", "foo\0\0bar\0", "'\0\";&"]) {
+            const cleanInput = input.replace(/\0/g, "");
+            const expected = shescape[method](cleanInput);
+            assert.deepStrictEqual(shescape[method](input), expected);
+            assert.deepStrictEqual(
+              shescape[method]({ toString: () => input }),
+              expected
+            );
+
+            if (method.endsWith("All")) {
+              assert.deepStrictEqual(
+                shescape[method](["safe", input, input]),
+                shescape[method](["safe", cleanInput, cleanInput])
+              );
+            }
+          }
+        });
+      }
+    });
+  }
